findings.evidence: "Verisign closes the connection on a 404 and curl prints error 56 after `404 https://rdap.verisign.com/...`". This is a vendor server behaviour that can change between releases. Unlike the IANA bootstrap fact (which gives its URL and "October 2026"), it has no source URL and no date checked.
findings.fix: Append the source and date to the sentence, for example "(observed against rdap.verisign.com, checked <date>; see docs/audit/recovery/domain-name-brainstormer/facts.md)". Alternatively, reword it as a live instruction: "classify from the printed `%{http_code} %{url_effective}` whatever curl's exit code". Keep the classify-on-non-zero-exit rule either way.
